meaning.en: not to understand something; to be mixed up

usage.en: be/get confused (about/by sth) · confuse A with B (mix up) · confusing = causing confusion. In speech: "I'm lost." = I can't follow; "Wait, what?"
usage.tr: be/get confused (about/by sth) · confuse A with B (karıştırmak) · confusing = kafa karıştırıcı. Konuşmada: "I'm lost." = takip edemiyorum; "Wait, what?"

sentences.en: I'm [confused] — are we meeting at six or seven?
sentences.tr: Kafam karıştı, altıda mı buluşuyoruz yedide mi?
sentences.de: Ich bin verwirrt – treffen wir uns um sechs oder um sieben?

sentences.en: Wait, I'm [lost]. Who's Daniel again?
sentences.tr: Dur, koptum. Daniel kimdi?
sentences.de: Moment, ich komme nicht mehr mit. Wer war noch mal Daniel?

meaning.en: to be stuck between two options (both attractive or both hard)
meaning.tr: iki seçenek arasında kalmak (ikisi de çekici ya da ikisi de zor)
meaning.de: zwischen zwei Möglichkeiten feststecken (beide verlockend oder beide schwer)

usage.en: be torn between A and B · be torn about/over sth
usage.tr: be torn between A and B · be torn about/over sth

sentences.en: I'm [torn between] staying here and moving back home.
sentences.tr: Burada kalmakla memlekete dönmek arasında kaldım.
sentences.de: Ich bin hin- und hergerissen, ob ich hierbleiben oder nach Hause zurückziehen soll.

sentences.en: I'm really [torn about] whether to tell her.
sentences.tr: Ona söyleyip söylememek konusunda ikilemdeyim.
sentences.de: Ich bin wirklich hin- und hergerissen, ob ich es ihr sagen soll.

meaning.en: not to have chosen a side yet; to be undecided
meaning.de: sich noch für keine Seite entschieden haben; unentschlossen sein

equivalent.de: unentschlossen sein, sich nicht festlegen wollen

literal.en: to sit on top of the fence (not coming down into either garden)
literal.tr: çitin üstünde oturmak (iki bahçeden birine inmemek)

usage.en: be/sit on the fence (about sth). "sit on the fence" can be mildly critical (avoiding taking sides).
usage.tr: be/sit on the fence (about sth). "sit on the fence" hafif eleştirel olabilir (taraf tutmaktan kaçınmak).

sentences.en: I'm still [on the fence] about going to the party.
sentences.tr: Partiye gidip gitmeme konusunda hâlâ kararsızım.
sentences.de: Ich bin noch unentschlossen, ob ich zur Party gehe.

sentences.en: He was [on the fence], but the salary convinced him.
sentences.tr: Kararsızdı ama maaş onu ikna etti.
sentences.de: Er war unentschlossen, aber das Gehalt hat ihn überzeugt.

meaning.en: to start doubting a decision you have made
meaning.tr: verdiği bir karardan şüphe etmeye başlamak
meaning.de: an einer getroffenen Entscheidung zu zweifeln beginnen

equivalent.de: Zweifel bekommen, es sich anders überlegen

usage.en: have second thoughts (about sth/V-ing). A separate formula: "on second thought" (AmE) / "on second thoughts" (BrE) = wait, I've changed my mind.
usage.tr: have second thoughts (about sth/V-ing). Ayrı kalıp: "on second thought" (AmE) / "on second thoughts" (BrE) = dur, fikrimi değiştirdim.

sentences.en: I'm [having second thoughts] about moving in with him.
sentences.tr: Onunla aynı eve çıkma konusunda tereddüt etmeye başladım.
sentences.de: Mir kommen Zweifel, ob ich mit ihm zusammenziehen soll.

sentences.en: I'll have the pasta. Actually, [on second thought], the burger.
sentences.tr: Makarna alayım. Yok, vazgeçtim, burger olsun.
sentences.de: Ich nehme die Pasta. Ach nein, doch lieber den Burger.

meaning.en: to feel both positive and negative about something
meaning.tr: bir konuda hem olumlu hem olumsuz hissetmek
meaning.de: etwas zugleich positiv und negativ empfinden

equivalent.tr: karışık duygular içinde olmak, buruk hissetmek

literal.en: to have feelings that are mixed

usage.en: have mixed feelings (about sth). Difference from torn: it's the FEELING that is mixed, not the decision.
usage.tr: have mixed feelings (about sth). Torn'dan farkı: karar değil, DUYGU karışık.

sentences.en: I have [mixed feelings] about graduating — excited but kind of sad.
sentences.tr: Mezuniyet konusunda duygularım karışık; heyecanlıyım ama biraz da hüzünlüyüm.
sentences.de: Ich habe gemischte Gefühle beim Abschluss – aufgeregt, aber auch ein bisschen traurig.

sentences.en: She's got [mixed feelings] about the new job.
sentences.tr: Yeni işle ilgili karışık duygular içinde.
sentences.de: Sie hat gemischte Gefühle, was den neuen Job angeht.

literal.en: to be unable to "form" your mind

usage.en: make up your mind (about sth) · "Make up your mind!" (impatient) · "My mind is made up." Don't confuse with: make up = reconcile / invent / cosmetics.
usage.tr: make up your mind (about sth) · "Make up your mind!" (sabırsız) · "My mind is made up." Karıştırma: make up = barışmak / uydurmak / makyaj.

sentences.en: I can't [make up my mind] about which laptop to buy.
sentences.tr: Hangi laptopu alacağıma karar veremiyorum.
sentences.de: Ich kann mich nicht entscheiden, welchen Laptop ich kaufen soll.

sentences.en: Come on, [make up your mind] — the waiter's been here three times.
sentences.tr: Hadi karar ver artık, garson üç kez geldi.
sentences.de: Komm schon, entscheide dich – der Kellner war schon dreimal da.

meaning.en: to keep switching between two ideas
meaning.tr: iki fikir arasında sürekli gidip gelmek
meaning.de: immer wieder zwischen zwei Gedanken hin- und herwechseln

equivalent.tr: bir öyle bir böyle düşünmek, gidip gelmek

usage.en: go back and forth (on/about sth). Second meaning: two people arguing or messaging at length.
usage.tr: go back and forth (on/about sth). İkinci anlam: iki kişinin uzun uzun tartışması/yazışması.

sentences.en: I keep [going back and forth] on whether to text him.
sentences.tr: Ona yazsam mı yazmasam mı diye gidip geliyorum.
sentences.de: Ich überlege ständig hin und her, ob ich ihm schreiben soll.

sentences.en: We [went back and forth] about it for weeks.
sentences.tr: Haftalarca bir o yana bir bu yana tartıştık.
sentences.de: Wir haben wochenlang hin und her überlegt.

expressions.expr: have no idea / not have a clue

equivalent.tr: en ufak fikri olmamak, hiçbir fikri yok
equivalent.de: keine Ahnung haben, keinen blassen Schimmer haben

variety.en: AmE + BrE (BrE: "I haven't got a clue.")
variety.tr: AmE + BrE (BrE: "I haven't got a clue.")

usage.en: have no idea / not have a clue + question word (what/why/how…). The adjective "clueless" = totally unaware (a mild insult).
usage.tr: have no idea / not have a clue + soru kelimesi (what/why/how…). "clueless" sıfatı = dünyadan bihaber (hafif hakaret).

sentences.en: I [have no idea] what he wants from me.
sentences.tr: Benden ne istediği hakkında hiçbir fikrim yok.
sentences.de: Ich habe keine Ahnung, was er von mir will.

sentences.en: I don't [have a clue] what I'm doing with my life.
sentences.tr: Hayatımla ne yaptığıma dair en ufak fikrim yok.
sentences.de: Ich habe keinen blassen Schimmer, was ich mit meinem Leben anfange.

expressions.expr: can't wrap / get one's head around

meaning.en: to be unable to grasp or accept something
meaning.de: etwas nicht begreifen oder akzeptieren können

equivalent.de: etwas nicht begreifen können, etwas will jemandem nicht in den Kopf

literal.en: to be unable to wrap your head around something

usage.en: can't wrap/get my head around sth / the fact that …
usage.tr: can't wrap/get my head around sth / the fact that …

sentences.en: I still can't [wrap my head around] the fact that she's gone.
sentences.tr: Onun gittiğini hâlâ aklım almıyor.
sentences.de: Ich kann immer noch nicht begreifen, dass sie nicht mehr da ist.

sentences.en: I can't [get my head around] these tax rules.
sentences.tr: Bu vergi kurallarına kafam basmıyor.
sentences.de: Diese Steuerregeln wollen mir nicht in den Kopf.

meaning.en: to confuse or unsettle someone with something unexpected
meaning.tr: beklenmedik bir şeyle birinin kafasını karıştırmak, dengesini bozmak
meaning.de: jemanden mit etwas Unerwartetem verwirren oder aus dem Konzept bringen

equivalent.de: jemanden aus dem Konzept bringen, jemanden irritieren

variety.en: AmE + BrE (in BrE mostly just "throw sb")

usage.en: sth throws sb (off) · be thrown (off) by sth. Don't confuse with: throw up = to vomit.
usage.tr: sth throws sb (off) · be thrown (off) by sth. Karıştırma: throw up = kusmak.

sentences.en: His question totally [threw me off].
sentences.tr: Sorusu kafamı tamamen karıştırdı.
sentences.de: Seine Frage hat mich völlig aus dem Konzept gebracht.

sentences.en: I was a bit [thrown] by her reaction.
sentences.tr: Tepkisi beni biraz şaşırttı.
sentences.de: Ihre Reaktion hat mich etwas irritiert.

meaning.en: to suddenly become afraid just before an important step and feel like backing out
meaning.tr: önemli bir adımın hemen öncesinde korkup vazgeçecek gibi olmak
meaning.de: kurz vor einem wichtigen Schritt plötzlich Angst bekommen und zurückziehen wollen

equivalent.tr: son anda korkmak, cayacak gibi olmak

usage.en: get/have cold feet (about sth). Especially for big decisions: marriage, moving, resigning.
usage.tr: get/have cold feet (about sth). Özellikle evlilik, taşınma, istifa gibi büyük kararlar için.

sentences.en: He [got cold feet] a week before the wedding.
sentences.tr: Düğünden bir hafta önce korkup tereddüde düştü.
sentences.de: Eine Woche vor der Hochzeit hat er kalte Füße bekommen.

sentences.en: I was going to ask for a raise, but I [got cold feet].
sentences.tr: Zam isteyecektim ama son anda cesaret edemedim.
sentences.de: Ich wollte um eine Gehaltserhöhung bitten, aber ich habe kalte Füße bekommen.
